capabilities: Embed HTML and MHTML files in notes with embed syntax
Target a specific element by ID in an embed
Zoom, search and refresh HTML files in a dedicated view
Sync dark theme styling into previewed HTML
Auto-reload embeds when the HTML file changes
extras: Not yet on the community marketplace; installed manually or via BRAT. Includes a donation link.
problem: Obsidian cannot preview HTML or MHTML files, and standard embeds cannot render them or target elements inside them.
summary: HTML/MHTML viewer that renders HTML files inline in notes or in a dedicated view with zoom, search, fullscreen and dark theme sync.
